verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Community Phone serves an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary. Many cited facts come from that file, including setup, porting, plans, app/dashboard management and coverage-check URLs, so an agent can be pointed at it to learn the service. missing for 10: no deeper agent-oriented technical docs (the OpenAPI/swagger probes all 404), and the llms.txt content is marketing-level rather than actionable task or reference documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.communityphone.org/llms.txt # Community Phone
Community Phone is a US home and business phone service.
Anyone can check their address at https://www.communityphone.org/coverage/check.
